script.name: Add Workshop mod to WorkshopItems and Mods
script.description: Adds the Workshop item to WorkshopItems and its mod ids to Mods in servertest.ini and the service variables. Skips sub-mods whose requirements are not installed. Applies on the next start.

script.name: Remove Workshop mod from WorkshopItems and Mods
script.description: Removes the Workshop item and its mod ids from servertest.ini and the service variables before the files are deleted. Applies on the next start.
